description: Local Linux OS operations: file reading/writing/deletion, shell execution, process monitoring, git version control, and Hyprland window manager automation.
routing_rules: Assign when inspecting local files, directory trees, terminal scripts, or git repositories.
Assign when managing desktop windows, workspaces, monitors, or notifications in Hyprland.

tools.name: sys_exec
tools.description: Executes a Linux bash or shell command with a timeout deadline, or launches background/GUI processes detached.

tools.name: tmux__list-sessions
tools.description: List all active tmux sessions.

tools.name: tmux__find-session
tools.description: Find a tmux session by name.

tools.name: tmux__list-windows
tools.description: List windows in a tmux session.

tools.name: tmux__list-panes
tools.description: List panes in a tmux window.

tools.name: tmux__capture-pane
tools.description: Capture content from a tmux pane with configurable lines count and optional color preservation.

tools.name: tmux__create-session
tools.description: Create a new tmux session.

tools.name: tmux__create-window
tools.description: Create a new window in a tmux session.

tools.name: tmux__kill-session
tools.description: Kill a tmux session by ID.

tools.name: tmux__kill-window
tools.description: Kill a tmux window by ID.

tools.name: tmux__kill-pane
tools.description: Kill a tmux pane by ID.

tools.name: tmux__split-pane
tools.description: Split a tmux pane horizontally or vertically.

tools.name: tmux__execute-command
tools.description: Execute a command in a tmux pane and get results. Use rawMode=true for interactive REPLs or editors.

tools.name: tmux__get-command-result
tools.description: Get the result of an executed command from tmux-mcp.

tools.name: sys_process
tools.description: Manages tracked background processes: list active jobs, inspect output logs, or terminate them.

tools.name: sys_ps
tools.description: Lists active operating system processes, memory usage, CPU, and PIDs.

tools.name: sys_kill
tools.description: Terminates an operating system process by process ID (PID) using POSIX signals.

tools.name: sys_exec_python
tools.description: Executes Python code in an isolated subprocess with a timeout.

tools.name: fs_read
tools.description: Reads file content with optional line slicing and offset limits.

tools.name: fs_write
tools.description: Atomically creates or overwrites a file, or appends content to an existing file.

tools.name: fs_delete
tools.description: Permanently deletes a file or directory tree from the filesystem.

tools.name: fs_list
tools.description: Lists contents of a directory with file sizes, types, and modified timestamps.

tools.name: fs_ripgrep
tools.description: Fast regex search across files and directories via ripgrep.

tools.name: git_status
tools.description: Retrieves git repository status, active branch, and modified files.

tools.name: git_diff
tools.description: Inspects git diff against HEAD, working tree, or specific commits.

tools.name: git_commit
tools.description: Stages all changes or specific files and creates a git commit with a message.

tools.name: hypr_get_active_window
tools.description: Gets the currently active/focused window in Hyprland with its title, class, address, workspace, pid, floating status, position, and size in JSON.

tools.name: hypr_get_workspaces
tools.description: Lists all active workspaces with their IDs, names, assigned monitors, window counts, and properties in JSON.

tools.name: hypr_get_clients
tools.description: Lists all open client windows across all workspaces in Hyprland with optional filtering by workspace, window class, or title.

tools.name: hypr_get_monitors
tools.description: Lists all connected monitors/displays, their resolutions, refresh rates, active workspaces, and focus states in JSON.

tools.name: hypr_dispatch
tools.description: Executes a keybind dispatcher or command through hyprctl dispatch with arguments (supports classic dispatchers and Lua expressions).

tools.name: hypr_switch_workspace
tools.description: Switches the active workspace on the current monitor to a target workspace (by ID, name, or relative offset like '+1', '-1', 'special:scratchpad').

tools.name: hypr_move_window
tools.description: Moves a window to a target workspace or in a direction (l/r/u/d), with optional silent mode.

tools.name: hypr_focus_window
tools.description: Focuses a specific window by class, title regex, or address.

tools.name: hypr_window_action
tools.description: Performs layout and state actions on a window: toggle floating, fullscreen, pin, center, or move focus.

tools.name: hypr_close_window
tools.description: Gracefully closes the active window or a specified window in Hyprland.

tools.name: hypr_notify
tools.description: Sends a desktop notification directly through Hyprland's built-in notification system.

tools.name: hypr_keyword
tools.description: Sets a dynamic Hyprland config keyword (e.g. 'general:border_size 2') or forces a reload of the Hyprland configuration.
